info.title: By the Grace of the Gods
info.synopsis: Ryouma Takuma, un uomo di 39 anni con un passato nascosto, si ritrova in una strana stanza bianca. Gli dei gli dicono che è morto e che stanno mandando la sua anima in un mondo parallelo, un mondo dove esiste la magia.

episodes.title: Episodio 1
episodes.synopsis: Ryoma Takebayashi is a young boy living by himself in a forest, who, in a previous lifetime, used to be a tortured middle-aged Japanese office worker. He meets a group of distressed travelers in the forest, and decides to save them.

tmdb.title: Episodio 1
tmdb.synopsis: Ryoma Takebayashi is a young boy living by himself in a forest, who, in a previous lifetime, used to be a tortured middle-aged Japanese office worker. He meets a group of distressed travelers in the forest, and decides to save them.

episodes.title: Episodio 2
episodes.synopsis: It turns out that the travelers Ryoma saved were the local duke and his family. Impressed by Ryoma's various skills and enamored by his personality, they offer to take Ryoma along on their journey.

episodes.title: Episodio 3
episodes.synopsis: Ryoma and the Jamil family travel to Gimul, a mining town. There, Ryoma and Eliaria take the first steps in becoming professionals in their crafts. Ryoma is given another opportunity to flex his new powers.

episodes.title: Episodio 4
episodes.synopsis: Ryoma arrives at Miya's house, overflowing with trash from a nearby dump. Ryoma and his slimes show a remarkable ability to clean, a skill that, as it turns out, the town of Gimul desperately needs.

episodes.title: Episodio 5
episodes.synopsis: Eliaria and Ryoma practice magic and combat in Gimul. They practice fighting against the weak but numerous monsters now infesting the abandoned mine shafts.

episodes.title: Episodio 6
episodes.synopsis: The Adventurer's Guild sets up a large-scale group of adventurers to deal with the massive monster infestation discovered in the abandoned mines. Ryoma joins them.

tmdb.title: Episodio 6

episodes.title: Episodio 7
episodes.synopsis: Ryoma decides to strike out on his own as an adventurer and business owner. He discusses his plans with the ducal family, and works with Serge the merchant to put his business plans in motion.

tmdb.title: Episodio 7
tmdb.synopsis: Ryoma decides to strike out on his own as an adventurer and business owner. He discusses his plans with the ducal family, and works with Serge the merchant to put his business plans in motion.

episodes.title: Episodio 8
episodes.synopsis: The laundry business is ready to open. Ryoma hires new employees to help get his business started, and throws a party to express his thanks to the friends who have supported him thus far.

episodes.title: Episodio 9
episodes.synopsis: The laundry business explodes in popularity, so Ryoma rushes out on day two to hire more help. He meets Fei and Li Ling, foreigners with a hidden past.

episodes.title: Episodio 10
episodes.synopsis: With the business going more smoothly than Ryoma ever imagined, Ryoma is able to go back to studying his slimes and adventuring. He discovers several new types of slimes.

episodes.title: Episodio 11
episodes.synopsis: The Jamil ducal family are all experts in the art of monster taming magic. Ryoma and Eliaria receive the Jamil elders' tutelage to further hone their taming magic.

episodes.title: Episodio 12
episodes.synopsis: Ryoma and Eliaria make another attempt to tame the limour birds. If they succeed, it would be a great milestone in their careers as monster tamers. However, whatever the outcome, their separation is inevitable as Eliaria leaves for school.
